lastWeekReview.title: The Tabernacle—God's Dwelling Place
bullets: On the mountain God gave Moses the BLUEPRINTS for a house — the tabernacle!
It was a place for God to meet with man and man to meet with God.
God wanted to come CLOSE and dwell right among His people.
He gave exact plans: 12 materials (minerals, plants, animals), the pattern, and furnishings.
God is the best Architect — every detail had a purpose, because it was HIS house.
God doesn't want to be far away — He always wants to be close to His dear ones!
lastWeekReview.discussion: Did you find a quiet moment each day to be close to God this week — talking, thanking, or singing to Him? Share what it was like!
lastWeekReview.verseQuote: "…To dwell in the house of Jehovah all the days of my life." — Psalm 27:4

kidsContent.text: For almost 40 years the children of Israel traveled through the wilderness. Now they were getting ready to enter the land God promised them!
But enemies lived there, so Israel would have to fight for it. Fighting a whole land of enemies is NOT a one-person job — it takes a huge, coordinated army!
So God formed His people into an army. He told Moses to NUMBER everyone by their families and their fathers' households.
God told each tribe exactly where to camp — around the tabernacle, on four sides, all FACING the tent where God dwelt. They all faced God!
🌟 It wasn't their choice where to camp — it was GOD's. And what a wonderful, orderly arrangement it was!

image.caption: The children of Israel encamped by their families

kidsContent.text: The children of Israel couldn't just pack up and go their own way. God needed them to STAY with His people to be part of His army.
Sometimes we wish we were in a DIFFERENT family — one with more toys, fewer brothers and sisters, or fewer rules. (The storyteller wished that too when she was young!)
But God placed YOU in your family on purpose. It is the very best family for you to grow up loving Him!
You and your family are part of a huge army — God's army! You can be glad, obey your parents, and grow up to serve God.
🌟 We want to be those who ACCEPT where God has placed us — right here among God's people!

lesson.practicePoint: This week, thank God for YOUR family — even the hard parts! And obey your parents in one thing without grumbling. You're part of God's army!

memoryVerse.text: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father, of whom every family in the heavens and on earth is named.
memoryVerse.application: Every family gets its name from God the Father — including yours! God is the One who arranges families and places each of us right where we belong, in His great household.

parts.text: Materials: A 'tabernacle' box or marker for the center, four side signs (North/South/East/West), colored tribe cards or ribbons, number badges
Setup: Put the 'tabernacle' in the center of the room and mark the four sides around it.
Round 1 — Numbered by Family: Kids count off and each gets a tribe color. Group together by tribe, just like Moses numbered the people by families.
Round 2 — Take Your Place: Each tribe goes to its assigned side and lines up FACING the center tabernacle (not facing out!). The leader checks that everyone is facing God.
Round 3 — On the Move: When the leader calls 'March!', tribes move together in order — an army moves together, never alone!
📖 Connection: God chose each tribe's place, all facing Him. We can be glad to take our place in God's orderly army!

rolePlayScript.text: Scene: A living room. Mimi is grumpy, arms crossed, after an argument with her sisters.
When Mimi was young, whenever she got mad at her sisters or thought her parents were too strict, she wished she was in a different family.
Ugh! Why can't I be in Nancy's family? She's an only child, she gets any toy she wants, and she doesn't even have to go to meetings!
Mimi, God placed you in OUR family for a reason. Come — it's time to go be with God's people.
But I didn't get to CHOOSE my family. Why do I have to stay with everyone?
Just like the children of Israel, Mimi couldn't just go her own way. God numbered His people by families and placed each one on purpose — all part of His army.
God PLACED me here… on purpose? Even my noisy little sisters?
Yes! Every family is named by God the Father. He chose the very best family for you to grow up loving Him.
Years later, older Mimi looks back and smiles.
You know what? God was right. My family was the best place for me — this is where I learned to love God and become part of His army!
We accept where God has placed us — glad to be with God's people, part of God's army!

description.text: Setup: Place a 'tabernacle' marker in the center. Split kids into 3–4 'tribes,' each with a color and a home side.
Rules: Tribes scatter and mingle. On 'To your tents!' each tribe races to gather on its OWN side and line up FACING the center.
Check: First tribe fully together AND facing the tabernacle wins the round.
Twist: On 'March!', all tribes must move one side clockwise — staying together and still facing in — an army moves in order!
📖 Connection: God arranged every tribe around Himself, all facing Him. We find our place in God's orderly army!
Materials: Center marker, four side signs, tribe color ribbons
Setup: Kids line up behind one 'commander' (leader). Everyone is a soldier in God's army.
Rules: The commander calls marching moves — 'Forward march!', 'Halt!', 'About face!', 'Quiet march!' — and the whole army must move together in step.
Out of Step: Anyone who moves on 'Halt!' or goes the wrong way does 5 jumping jacks and rejoins the ranks.
Team mode: Split into two squads and see which army can follow the commands together most sharply.
📖 Connection: A great army moves TOGETHER, in order — not each person doing their own thing. That's how God's people go to battle!
Materials: Open space, optional drum or whistle
Divide kids into tribes; give each tribe a 'banner' (a colored flag or cloth) planted at their base on one side of the field.
Goal: Stay together as a tribe and protect your banner while trying to spot the other tribes' banners — an army works as a team.
Rule: You may never leave your tribe alone — soldiers move in groups of two or more, always together!
Finish: All tribes gather in the center facing a marked 'tabernacle' and give a cheer for being part of God's army.
Materials: Colored flags/cloths, base markers, a center marker

outdoor.tip: 🚩 The lesson is belonging and order: God places each of us in a family and among His people on purpose. Help kids feel glad to take their place — nobody serves God alone; we're all part of His army.
